findings.description: Completed lessons were checked for heading presence only. Reordered, duplicate, extra and code-fenced headings incorrectly passed.
findings.expected_result: Reject all four malformed completed lessons.
findings.actual_result: Before fix: four regression tests failed because malformed lessons were accepted. After fix: exact ordered real H2 headings required.
findings.root_cause: Independent presence regexes did not validate ordering, cardinality, or Markdown code fences.
findings.proposed_fix: Compare the ordered H2 headings outside code against the 25 required titles; retain missing-title diagnostics.
findings.verification_status: 284 validator/generator tests passed; four negative regression cases retained; final full suite recorded separately

findings.description: The surviving Phase 4 checkpoint confirms prior phases complete and authorizes Phase 4, but does not explicitly record Phase 3 owner review approval. Historical Phase 3 handoff and catalog snapshot still say pending.
findings.reproduction_command: rg -n 'previous phases complete|Phase 3|owner review pending' docs/divide-conquer-checkpoints.md docs/divide-conquer-evidence/catalog-baseline.yaml
findings.expected_result: An explicit historical Phase 3 owner-approval record, separate from implementation completion.
findings.actual_result: Completion and next-phase authorization are recorded; an explicit Phase 3 approval statement was not located.
findings.root_cause: Historical approval wording is less explicit than adjacent phase checkpoints.
findings.proposed_fix: Owner may supply the earlier approval record or clarify it at review. Preserve historical evidence; do not infer or backdate approval.
findings.verification_status: confirmed documentary ambiguity; no algorithm or test failure

findings.description: 24 of 92 external URL retrievals could not be verified through the browsing service; 68 were retrieved. Failures include access restrictions, timeouts, cache misses and a large PDF.
findings.reproduction_command: Open the URLs marked unverified-access-error in evidence/external-links.json using an independent browser.
findings.expected_result: Observe external reference availability independently of local Markdown-link validation.
findings.actual_result: 68 retrieved; 24 access errors; no confirmed HTTP 404 in this check. These errors do not establish that the links are broken.
findings.root_cause: External source and retrieval-service access limitations.
findings.proposed_fix: Review the listed URLs in an ordinary browser; replace a reference only if it is independently confirmed broken.
findings.verification_status: all URLs attempted; restricted results explicitly unverified
